title: Parking Tenure Uplift on the Storage Bundle Rate of a Parking License
content:
Training note. A Parking License that has been held for a year or more earns a parking tenure uplift on its storage bundle discount rate.

**What is the rule?** When the license has been held at least 730 days, the parking tenure uplift is 0.02; when it has been held at least 365 but fewer than 730 days, the parking tenure uplift is 0.01; in every other case there is no parking tenure uplift. The parking tenure uplift is added to the bundle rate.

**How is "held" measured?** In days from the license's start date to the handling date.

**What are the steps?**

| Days the Parking License has been held | Parking tenure uplift |
|---|---|
| 730 or more | 0.02 (2 points) |
| 365 to 729 | 0.01 (1 point) |
| fewer than 365 | none |

**Where are the edges?** Held 730 days: 0.02. Held 729 days: 0.01. Held 365 days: 0.01. Held 364 days: none.
